metaDescription: Mineral rights owner near Alden on Torch Lake? Split-estate ownership is common here, and so is a mature Antrim royalty. Get a straight evaluation.
heroLead: Alden sits right on Torch Lake, and the split between who owns the lakefront and who owns the minerals underneath it is one of the most common questions we get out of this part of Antrim County.
intro: Alden is a small community on the west shore of Torch Lake in Antrim County, prime recreational real estate today, but the mineral estate under a lot of that lakefront and the farmland further back from the shore was leased and, in places, drilled during the Antrim Shale boom of the late 1980s and 1990s, well before most of the current cottage owners bought their property.

sections.heading: Split estate is the norm around Torch Lake
paragraphs: Because so much land around Alden and Torch Lake changed hands for resort and cottage development over the decades, it's common for the mineral rights to have been reserved by an earlier owner or sold off entirely separate from the lakefront lot itself. If you own property near Alden and have never seen a royalty check, that may simply mean you don't hold the mineral estate, not that there's no oil and gas activity in the area.

On the flip side, if you're getting a small check tied to land near Alden that you don't own the surface of, that's the other half of the same split-estate pattern, and it's completely normal for this stretch of Antrim County.

sections.heading: What a mature Antrim interest near Alden pays today
paragraphs: Where wells were drilled near Alden during the boom years, they're now well past peak production, producing the long, flat, small-volume tail typical of biogenic Antrim gas this far into a well's life. We price interests here off current statements and production, not what the well made in the 1990s, and we'll tell you plainly if the honest number is modest.

faqs.question: I own a cottage near Alden on Torch Lake. Do I own the minerals under it?
faqs.answer: Not automatically. Check your deed for mineral reservation language, since a lot of lakefront property here was sold with the mineral rights kept back by a prior owner or a developer.

faqs.question: Is Torch Lake area production part of the Antrim Shale play?
faqs.answer: Yes, Antrim County including the Alden area sits in the historic Antrim Shale core, though drilling density varies by section and not every parcel was drilled.

faqs.question: How do I check whether my Alden-area mineral interest is being produced?
faqs.answer: Contact the Antrim County register of deeds in Bellaire to pull your chain of title, and check with any operator listed on your paperwork for current production status and a division order.
